environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No request inspection or validation is performed at the load balancer layer. The application relies solely on Gin's struct binding validation (required fields, min/max on integers) and the sanitizeInput function for security.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB, default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, appuser has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on products schema
config.network: ALB -> private subnet -> ECS task -> RDS (port 5432)
config.request_validation: Gin struct binding only (type checking, required, min/max on numeric fields)
